    A₀ and its evaluated modules as graded objects #

    Section 6: "Let M_1, …, M_h be the degree-normalized graded indecomposable A₀-modules obtained by evaluating the objects of C: the degree-d part at x is C_d(P_x, X_i)." Here A₀ = (Alg F₀)ᵒᵖ is ℤ-graded through lenA0 (galgA0), and the evaluation M_X = Rep F₀ X of an object X of the mesh category is a graded right A₀-module (gmodEv), with m·a = a.unop • m.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
